customMethods.script:
# Get the data
	data = []
	
	for record in self.view.custom.table.selection.data:
		chkShtId = record['chkShtId']
		
		if (chkShtId or None) is None: continue
		checkSheet = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetRowToJSON(system.kanoa.quality.sheet.getSheets({'chkShtId': chkShtId}), 0)		# get check sheet
		
		if checkSheet is None or checkSheet['chkShtId'] is None: continue
		
		# get check sheet type
		folderId = checkSheet['chkShtTypeId']
		sheetTypes = []
		while True:
			sheetType = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetRowToJSON(system.kanoa.quality.sheet.getSheetTypes({'chkShtTypeId': folderId}), 0)
			sheetTypes = [sheetType] + sheetTypes
			folderId = sheetType['parentId']
			
			if folderId is None: break
		
		triggers = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.quality.config.getChkShtTriggers({'chkShtId': chkShtId}))		# get check sheet triggers 
		itemGroups = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.quality.config.getGroups({'chkShtId': chkShtId}))				# get check item groups
		checkItems = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.quality.config.getChecks({'chkShtId': chkShtId}))				# get check items
		
		checkItemDataTypes = {}
		checkItemEngineeringUnits = {}
		checkItemTypes = {}
		checkItemPickLists = {}
		
		for item in checkItems:
			if item and 'pickListValues' in item and item['pickListValues']: item['pickListValues'] = item['pickListValues'].replace('\"', "'")
			
			if item['dataTypeId'] is not None and not item['dataTypeId'] in checkItemDataTypes:	checkItemDataTypes[item['dataTypeId']] = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetRowToJSON(system.kanoa.quality.config.getDataTypes({'dataTypeId': item['dataTypeId']}), 0)
			if item['engUnitId'] is not None and not item['engUnitId'] in checkItemEngineeringUnits: 	checkItemEngineeringUnits[item['engUnitId']] = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetRowToJSON(system.kanoa.quality.config.getUnits({'engUnitId': item['engUnitId']}), 0)
			if item['chkItemTypeId'] is not None and not item['chkItemTypeId'] in checkItemTypes: checkItemTypes[item['chkItemTypeId']] = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetRowToJSON(system.kanoa.quality.config.getCheckItemTypes({'chkItemTypeId': item['chkItemTypeId']}), 0)
			if item['pickListId'] is not None and not item['pickListId'] in checkItemPickLists:
				pickList = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetRowToJSON(system.kanoa.quality.config.getPickList({'pickListId': item['pickListId']}), 0)
				pickList['example'] = pickList['example'].replace('\"', "'")
				checkItemPickLists[item['pickListId']] = pickList
			
			if item['calculation']: 
				item['calculation'] = item['calculation'].replace('\"', "'")
		
		checkItemDataTypes = checkItemDataTypes.values()
		checkItemEngineeringUnits = checkItemEngineeringUnits.values()
		checkItemTypes = checkItemTypes.values()
		checkItemPickLists = checkItemPickLists.values()
		
		# get attributes
		attributes = {}
		
		def addAttr(attrId, linkId=None):
			
			if attrId is None: return
			if attrId in attributes:
				if not linkId in attributes: attributes[attrId]['linkIds'].append(linkId)
				return
			
			attr = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetRowToJSON(system.kanoa.quality.config.getAttributes({'attributeId': attrId}), 0)
			attr['dataSource'] = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.quality.config.getDataSource({'attributeId': attrId})) 			# get attribute data source
			attr['tolerances'] = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.quality.config.getTolerances({'attributeId': attrId}))			# get attributes
			attr['linkIds'] = [linkId] if linkId else []
			attributes[attrId] = attr
			addAttr(attr['parentId'])
			
			return
			
		
		for item in checkItems:
			if item['chkItemAttrLinkId']:
				attributeId = system.db.runScalarPrepQuery('SELECT attributeId FROM qds.chkItemAttrLink WHERE chkItemAttrLinkId = ?', [item['chkItemAttrLinkId']], system.kanoa.config.getDBName('QDS'))
				addAttr(attributeId, item['chkItemAttrLinkId'])
		
		attributes = sorted(attributes.values(), key=lambda x: x['path'])
		
		assetLinks = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.quality.sheet.getAssets(chkShtId))		# get asset links
		itemLinks = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.quality.sheet.getItems(chkShtId))			# get item links
		itemSets = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.quality.sheet.getItemSets(chkShtId))		# get item sets
		
		for itemSet in itemSets:
			itemSet['links'] = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.quality.config.getItemSetLinks({'itemSetId': itemSet['itemSetId']}))
			
			for linkedItem in itemSet['links']:
				linkedItem['itemName'] = linkedItem['itemName'].replace('"', 'in') 
				linkedItem['itemPath'] = linkedItem['itemPath'].replace('"', 'in')
		
		data.append({
			'chkSht': checkSheet,
			'chkShtTypes': sheetTypes,
			'chkShtTriggers': triggers,
			'chkItemGroups': itemGroups,
			'chkItems': checkItems,
			'chkItemDataTypes': checkItemDataTypes,
			'chkItemEngUnits': checkItemEngineeringUnits,
			'chkItemTypes': checkItemTypes,
			'chkItemPickLists': checkItemPickLists,
			'assetLinks': assetLinks,
			'itemLinks': itemLinks,
			'itemSets': itemSets,
			'attributes': attributes
		})
	
	# Get the label
	if len(data) == 0: label = 'No Data'
	elif len(data) == 1: label = data[0]['chkSht']['chkShtName']
	elif len(data) <= 3: label = ', '.join([x['chkSht']['chkShtName'] for x in data])
	else: label = '%s et al.'%data[0]['chkSht']['chkShtName']
	
	return {'data': data or None, 'label': label}
